title: 印度UPI：已接入多国，能否成为国际支付标准？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: India's reforms express will pick up pace and move ahead.
segments.zh: 印度的改革将加速推进。

segments.en: India's UPI has reached many nations, but this is just the first step.
segments.zh: 印度的UPI已覆盖多国，但这只是第一步。

segments.en: Our next goal now should be to connect our payments systems with other countries.
segments.zh: 下一步目标是与更多国家实现支付系统互联。
